body:
Track 7, milestone 5. Trains surrogates (non-negative linear, ridge, boosted trees) on 24 cheap word-level RTL features to predict Yosys generic-gate cell counts over 133 designs in four generator families. Reports in-family and leave-one-family-out error, and a screening replay.

Headline (from `experiments/results.txt`): 3.9% median error in-family; 10.5% to 210.7% on a held-out family, rank agreement Spearman 0.75 to 1.00; screening finds a near-best design in 1-5 syntheses vs 12.4 (MAC) random. Stylised, synthesis-only target, no place and route; limitations are in the README.

Checks: 12 unit tests pass, `python3 site/build.py` prints ok.
